skills.name: aia-context-card
skills.title: My Context Card
skills.description: Build or improve a real estate professional’s reusable identity, voice, business context and working preferences. Use when setting up AI context or correcting how AI represents the member.

skills.name: aia-content
skills.title: Content
skills.description: Plan and draft real estate content from the member’s context, voice and source material. Use for posts, emails, content angles and production briefs; generation of images or video requires actual available tools.

skills.name: aia-listing-machine
skills.title: Listing Machine
skills.description: Turn supplied property facts into reusable listing context and requested launch materials. Use for listing descriptions, launch emails, open-house content or seller updates, not appraisals or unsupported pricing advice.

skills.name: aia-listing-photos
skills.title: Listing Photos
skills.description: Review listing images, prepare specific staging or editing directions, and use an available image tool to produce reviewable candidates. Use when the member supplies listing photos or requests staging; do not imply image generation is available without a callable tool.
